why: Multiple sources (Terry Tao's blog, John D. Cook, arXiv papers, news coverage) report that Levent Alpöge, working with Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, found a counterexample in July 2026 disproving the Jacobian conjecture for dimension 3 and, by extension, all dimensions n >= 3; the 2-dimensional (planar) case remains open. The counterexample was reportedly machine-verified in Lean and followed up by further arXiv papers generalizing it.
